hints.title: Group Counts
hints.text: Group identical integers by frequency count. The specific values do not matter, only frequencies.

hints.title: Sort Quantities Descending
hints.text: Sorting the customer quantity demands in descending order prunes failing branches earliest.

hints.title: Backtrack on Customer Allocation
hints.text: Try assigning each customer demand to any frequency bucket with sufficient capacity, backtracking if not satisfied.

hints.title: Full Implementation

variables: m is number of unique integer counts (<= 50)
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Trying all integer assignments element-by-element takes factorial time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Sorting quantities descending with frequency bucket backtracking terminates quickly on m <= 50, k <= 10.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize that sorting quantities descending drastically reduces recursion tree depth.
